en.headline: Three injured after paraglider lands on hikers at Ma On Shan campsite
en.dek: A woman and two teenagers were hurt when a paraglider hit them while landing at Ngong Ping campsite around noon on Sunday; a helicopter took them to hospital.
body: Police received a report at about 12:36 p.m. on Sunday that a woman hiking near Ngong Ping campsite in Ma On Shan Country Park had been struck by a paraglider during its landing.

The woman suffered a head injury with bleeding. Two teenage boys aged 14 and 16, reported to be her sons, also sustained injuries to their heads and backs. Rescuers reached the site, and the Government Flying Service deployed a helicopter to evacuate the three.

The injured were flown to the Wan Chai heliport and then transferred by ambulance to hospital for treatment. No further details on the paraglider pilot or the exact circumstances of the landing were immediately available.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山昂平營地滑翔傘降落撞傷三人 直升機送院
zh.dek: 周日中午一名女子與兩名青少年在馬鞍山昂平營地被降落的滑翔傘撞傷，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他們送往醫院治理。
body: 警方周日中午12時36分接獲報案，指一名女子在馬鞍山郊野公園昂平營地附近遠足時，被一名玩滑翔傘人士降落時撞到。
該女子頭部受傷出血，兩名分別14歲及16歲的青少年（損報為其兒子）亦頭部及背部受傷。救援人員到場後，政府飛行服務隊派出直升機將三人救出。
傷者由直升機送往灣仔停機坪，再轉乘救護車送院治理。現階段未有更多關於滑翔傘操縱員或降落具體情況的資料。
